<<Tuning Of A Street Organ, Briefly>>  
The neighborhood’s street organ was recently tuned to enhance its sound for community gatherings. Adjustments were made to the hinges and trestles to ensure proper alignment and resonance. The hinges were adjusted for stability, while the trestles were fine-tuned to balance the organ’s pitch. This tuning has improved the organ’s performance, making it a pleasant addition to the community’s daily life.
